claims.statement: Training induces useful compressibility at equal quality
claims.primary_metric: paired test NLL and compression delta
claims.acceptance_criterion: upper 95% paired CI <= +0.02 NLL; compressed delta <= +0.01
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: See paired main-training table: compressibility and equal-quality are reported separately; common recipe, bounded tuning, and plateau/continuation coverage limit generalization

claims.acceptance_criterion: controlled null-space effects across geometry/init/optimizer controls; marginal entropy alone insufficient
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: The limited preconditioning/null-update mechanism is observed; the stronger universal entropy/useless-null-space causal explanation is not established

claims.acceptance_criterion: upper block-bootstrap 95% CI <= +0.01 vs untouched; matched-byte INT4 and lowrank controls
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: One-shot plus bounded full Granite functional fitting were tested. Fitting improves NLL, but acceptance concerns the same-model +.01 tolerance; this is not a universal verdict on stronger PTQ recipes

claims.statement: Advertised bitrates match storage and memory
claims.acceptance_criterion: all factors/codes/scales/metadata counted; historical names not budgets
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: Measured payload/framing and complete archive totals differ from historical bitrate labels; native/generic/ternary/sign budgets are explicitly distinguished

claims.acceptance_criterion: CI resolves lower latency for same payload with fidelity reported jointly
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: Actual complete direct-packed Granite forward/generation and same-payload reference measured; see quality, resident storage, latency and fixed-process-order limit jointly

claims.statement: Streaming bounds memory and covers sources
claims.acceptance_criterion: complete manifest restoration and bounded live source buffer as source size increases
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: Complete fixture archives have full manifest coverage, bounded per-tensor source ranges, interruption/resume, raw fallback and fresh-process restoration; remote real matrices remain samples

claims.statement: Distributed training reduces time to quality
claims.primary_metric: actual multi-GPU time to common quality
claims.acceptance_criterion: measured complete training with identical global batches; single GPU cannot satisfy
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: Actual multi-GPU time-to-quality requires additional authorized devices; single-GPU algebra and bandwidth projections do not satisfy it

claims.acceptance_criterion: reproduce on declared task; separate quality
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: Legacy diagnostics reproduce improved Kronecker compressibility with worse uncompressed NLL; exact historical 13x configuration differs and one middle bank is not a multi-layer equal-quality result

claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: At the supplied 256x256 rank-8 shapes, generic/native factors alone exceed 0.5 bpw before framing; no 0.5-bpw no-loss result was reproduced

claims.acceptance_criterion: same configuration and actual expert computation
claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: Some individual fitted banks approach/exceed99.8% R²; the all-layer values vary and complete-model NLL still changes. Historical full-cascade fidelity is not established

claims.controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
claims.reason: CPU component ratios measured at actual shapes; no full-path 5x–10x claim or historical-workload identity established
